parsed.quote: For the purposes of that assessment, notified bodies which have been notified under that Union harmonisation legislation shall be entitled to control the conformity of the high-risk AI systems with the requirements set out in Section 2, provided that the compliance of those notified bodies with requirements laid down in Article 31(4), (5), (10) and (11) has been assessed in the context of the notification procedure under that Union harmonisation legislation.
parsed.answer: Article 43(3) sets no deadline for those notified bodies to apply for designation under Chapter III, Section 4. Instead, it permits bodies already notified under the relevant Union harmonisation legislation to assess high-risk AI systems, provided their compliance with the specified Article 31 requirements has been assessed through the notification procedure under that legislation. The question therefore presupposes a designation deadline that this provision does not contain.
